name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. I installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present), wrote the exact quickstart script from the docs, and made a chat completions API call to Fireworks. The model specified in the quickstart (`accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`) returned a 404 Not Found, so I listed available models and used `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` instead. The API returned a chat completion: "¡Hola!"
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned a 404 Not Found error (`Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed`). I had to call `client.models.list()` to discover available models and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` to successfully complete the API call.
